facts_found: Freezing a debit card is a temporary lock; closing is permanent deactivation. If the customer confirms the card is lost/stolen, the KB recommends closing instead of freezing. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_026]

Debit card freeze requires: customer verified, customer is the card owner, and the card currently in ACTIVE status (cannot freeze PENDING, CLOSED, or already FROZEN cards). [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_026]

Debit freeze steps: verify identity, ask reason, inform customer (new transactions and recurring payments declined; already-authorized pending transactions may still process; can unfreeze via phone or mobile app), then call freeze_debit_card_3892 with the card_id and confirm success. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_026]

Freezing does not affect ATM access if the customer has their PIN; for ATM freeze the customer must separately enable 'ATM Block' through the mobile app. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_026]

Debit card closure requires verified customer, card ownership, and card in ACTIVE or PENDING status; reasons 'lost', 'stolen', and 'fraud_suspected' bypass the 14-day minimum card age requirement. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_025]
Cards reported as lost or stolen are closed immediately with no cooling-off period; use close_debit_card_4721 with parameters card_id and reason. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_025]

For fraud_suspected debit closures, recommend the customer also change their online banking password; advise reviewing recent transactions and filing disputes for unauthorized charges. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_025]

Cross-product security protocol: when a customer reports a lost or stolen debit card, the agent must (1) complete the standard debit card freeze/close procedure, (2) check for Rho-Bank credit cards on file, (3) proactively offer to order a replacement credit card, and (4) explain that wallet theft often involves multiple cards. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_030]
Use get_credit_card_accounts_by_user to retrieve all active and closed credit card accounts for the customer. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_030]
If the customer declines the credit card replacement offer, the agent must note in the account that the offer was made. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_030]

The KB documents no agent tool to freeze or lock a credit card; the documented credit-card protection path for a stolen/lost card is ordering a replacement credit card. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_replacements_001]

Replacement credit card procedure: verify identity using standard verification procedures, look up the credit card account, confirm shipping address, record a replacement reason, ask about expedited shipping, confirm eligibility, then unlock order_replacement_credit_card_7291 with unlock_discoverable_agent_tool and call it with call_discoverable_agent_tool. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_replacements_001]
After a replacement credit card order is submitted, the old card is automatically cancelled for security and will no longer work for new purchases. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_replacements_001]

For reason fraud_suspected or stolen, strongly recommend expedited shipping (2-3 business days) and remind the customer to review recent transactions and dispute unauthorized charges. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_replacements_001]

Credit card expedited shipping fees by tier: Entry-tier (Bronze Rewards, EcoCard, Business Bronze) $15.00; Mid-tier (Silver Rewards, Business Silver, Green Rewards, Silver Zoom) $10.00; Premium-tier and above (Gold, Platinum, Diamond Elite) $0.00 complimentary. Standard delivery 7-10 business days, no fee. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_replacements_001]

Customer self-service credit card control: 'Lock your card in the app to block new charges' is the first immediate action when fraudulent activity is suspected; re-enable the card only when confident it is secure. [doc_credit_cards_platinum_rewards_card_004]

Credit card controls include temporarily locking the card if misplaced and unlocking when found, and replacing the card number quickly if compromise is suspected. [doc_credit_cards_platinum_rewards_card_003]

Use get_debit_cards_by_account_id_7823(account_id) to retrieve all debit cards for a checking account; it returns card_id, status (ACTIVE, PENDING, FROZEN, CLOSED), issue_reason, and limits. Savings accounts do not have debit cards. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_028]

Use get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847(user_id) to retrieve the customer's checking and savings accounts (account_id, account_type, account_class, status, balance, date_opened). [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_009]

A debit card already reported stolen (decline CODE 43) requires ENHANCED verification — full name, date of birth, last 4 of SSN, and confirmation of 2-3 recent transactions — and stolen cards cannot be reactivated; a replacement with a new number must be ordered. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_037]

Transfer reason code 'fraud_or_security_concern' is Tier 1 (highest priority) and is used for fraud, identity theft, unauthorized transactions, or security concerns requiring specialist handling. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_042]

When filing a credit card dispute for an unauthorized/fraudulent charge, the card_action parameter value 'cancel_and_reissue' is used when the card is being cancelled and a replacement issued. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_014]

Unfreezing steps: 1) Verify customer identity; 2) Use unfreeze_debit_card_3893 with the card_id; 3) Confirm the card is now active and ready to use immediately. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_026]

FREEZE is a temporary lock that can be reversed; CLOSE is permanent deactivation and cannot be reversed. If the customer confirms the card is lost/stolen, the KB recommends closing instead of freezing (i.e., do not unfreeze). [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_026]

A customer can unfreeze at any time either by calling customer service or through the mobile app; while frozen all new transactions and recurring payments/subscriptions are declined, though already-authorized pending transactions may still process. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_026]

Freezing does not affect ATM access if the customer has their PIN; to block ATM use the customer must separately enable 'ATM Block' in the mobile app (so it must also be separately disabled after unfreezing). [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_026]
If a frozen card is not unfrozen within 90 days the customer receives a reminder notification (no automatic closure or expiry of the freeze is stated). [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_026]

facts_found: Credit card transaction disputes (including unauthorized/fraudulent charges) are filed by the agent using the file_credit_card_transaction_dispute_4829 tool; the agent must first unlock the tool with unlock_discoverable_agent_tool and then call it with call_discoverable_agent_tool passing a JSON string of all required arguments. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_014]

The card_action value 'cancel_and_reissue' is used when the card is being cancelled and a replacement issued, and applies whether the replacement was already ordered via order_replacement_credit_card_7291 or the cancellation happens as part of the dispute — i.e. it is still the correct value for cards already cancelled and replaced. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_014]

file_credit_card_transaction_dispute_4829 requires transaction_id, card_action, card_last_4_digits, full_name, user_id, phone, email, address, contacted_merchant, purchase_date, issue_noticed_date, dispute_reason, resolution_requested, optional partial_refund_amount, and eligible_for_provisional_credit. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_014]
dispute_reason 'unauthorized_fraudulent_charge' is the value for a charge that was not authorized or is fraudulent. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_014]

contacted_merchant is a required boolean on the credit card dispute tool, but merchant contact is only a substantive requirement for non-fraud disputes; for 'unauthorized_fraudulent_charge' the customer is not required to have contacted the merchant first. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_014]
eligible_for_provisional_credit must be determined by the agent using the Provisional Credit Eligibility Guidelines and passed as true or false. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_014]

Credit card provisional credit requires ALL of: account open at least 60 days; dispute reason is 'unauthorized_fraudulent_charge', 'duplicate_charge', or 'goods_services_not_received' (purchase >30 days ago); transaction amount at least $25.00 and not exceeding the card tier's maximum provisional credit limit; no more than 2 disputes filed in the past 12 months; and (for non-fraud reasons only) merchant contacted first. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_015]

Maximum credit card provisional credit by tier: Entry Tier (Bronze Rewards, EcoCard, Business Bronze, Crypto-Cash Back) $2500.00; Mid Tier (Silver Rewards, Business Silver, Green Rewards, Silver Zoom) $5000.00; Premium Tier (Gold Rewards, Business Gold) $10000.00; Elite Tier (Platinum Rewards, Business Platinum) $15000.00; Invitation Tier (Diamond Elite) $25000.00. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_015]

Credit card disputes are NOT eligible for provisional credit if the account is under 60 days old, the reason is 'incorrect_amount', 'goods_services_not_as_described', 'canceled_subscription_still_charging' or 'refund_never_processed', the amount is under $25.00 or exceeds the tier cap, or (for non-fraud disputes) the merchant was not contacted first. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_015]

Credit card dispute history (needed for the 'no more than 2 disputes in the past 12 months' test) is retrieved with get_user_dispute_history_7291(user_id), which returns dispute_id, dispute_date, status, transaction_id, transaction_date, merchant_name, amount, currency and card_last4. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_016]

Provisional credit on a credit card is a temporary credit applied usually within a few business days of the dispute being filed; it becomes permanent if the dispute is resolved in the customer's favor and is reversed (charge reappears) if not. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_022]

Credit card investigation duration is not fixed in the KB — it 'can take anywhere from a few days to several weeks depending on the complexity of the case'. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_022]

Customer-facing guidance: unauthorized/fraudulent charges are a valid dispute reason; contacting the merchant first is recommended generally, but for charges that appear fraudulent customers are told to contact Rho-Bank right away; representatives gather the information and file the dispute on the customer's behalf. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_018]

Replacement credit cards are ordered with order_replacement_credit_card_7291 (unlock then call_discoverable_agent_tool) with reason one of fraud_suspected, lost, stolen, damaged, expired, or other; ordering automatically cancels the old card. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_replacements_001]

Credit card replacement shipping fees by tier: Standard 7-10 business days free; Expedited 2-3 business days costs $15.00 for Entry tier (Bronze Rewards, EcoCard, Business Bronze), $10.00 for Mid tier, and $0.00 (complimentary) for Premium tier and above (Gold, Platinum, Diamond Elite). [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_replacements_001]

For replacement reasons fraud_suspected or stolen, the agent should strongly recommend expedited shipping and remind the customer to review recent transactions and dispute any unauthorized charges. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_replacements_001]

The lost/stolen cross-product security protocol has the agent themselves complete the debit freeze/close, check for credit cards with get_credit_card_accounts_by_user, and offer a credit card replacement — it does not require transferring to a human or fraud team. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_030]

The documented 'escalate to security team' triggers (bank-initiated fraud alert, unverifiable identity, suspected impostor, suspicious explanation) appear in the debit-card security-alert/block management procedure governing clear_debit_card_fraud_alert_4892, not in the credit card dispute procedure. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_039]

The 60-day / 2-business-day liability deadlines and the 10-business-day provisional credit requirement are Regulation E rules that apply to debit card and electronic fund transfer disputes; Regulation E explicitly does not cover credit cards, which are covered by different regulations. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_037]

The credit card dispute tool takes card_last_4_digits (not a card_id or account_id), so the last four digits of the original cancelled card are the correct identifier to pass for each disputed transaction. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_014]

A pending dispute on a credit card account is a blocking condition for other servicing actions (e.g. credit limit increase and account closure), so filing disputes has downstream effects the agent should be aware of. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_007]

facts_found: The Green Account debit card dbc_tm92c4d7e8_green (ending 8524) was frozen on 11/14/2025 and the customer has since located the physical card, so it was not lost or stolen (established prior to this search; the card_id is the value to pass as card_id). [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_026]

close_debit_card_4721 requires the debit card to currently be in ACTIVE or PENDING status (FROZEN is not an eligible status for closure); if a requirement is not met the agent must inform the customer what needs to be resolved and not proceed with closure. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_025]

Reasons 'lost', 'stolen', or 'fraud_suspected' bypass the 14-day minimum card age requirement for security purposes, and cards reported lost or stolen are closed immediately with no cooling-off period. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_025]

Closure also requires no pending/processing transactions and no pending refunds (otherwise wait for settlement, or for refunds wait 3-5 business days or obtain written acknowledgment that refunds will be credited to the linked checking account); for lost/stolen the customer must be told pending transactions will still be processed and asked whether they want a replacement ordered immediately. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_025]

Unfreezing requires: verified customer, card owner, card currently FROZEN, linked checking account still OPEN; the agent uses unfreeze_debit_card_3893 with the card_id and confirms the card is active immediately. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_026]

Replacement debit cards are ordered with order_debit_card_5739, and the agent must provide the exact delivery_fee and design_fee amounts based on the account-tier rules; all shipping, design and excess-replacement fees are automatically charged to the linked checking account when the card is ordered. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_029]

ENTRY tier replacement rules: maximum 2 replacement cards per rolling 12-month period; 48-hour waiting period after card closure before a replacement can be ordered; standard shipping only (no expedited option available) with delivery_fee $0; $25 excess replacement fee if the limit is exceeded; design fees CLASSIC $0, PREMIUM $10, CUSTOM $25. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_029]

MID tier replacement rules: maximum 3 replacement cards per rolling 12-month period; no waiting period (can order immediately after closure); standard delivery_fee $0 or expedited delivery_fee $15; $15 excess replacement fee if limit exceeded; design fees CLASSIC $0, PREMIUM $10, CUSTOM $25. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_029]

PREMIUM tier: max 5 replacements/12 months, no waiting period, expedited free (delivery_fee $0 for STANDARD and EXPEDITED), rush delivery_fee $35, design fees CLASSIC $0 / PREMIUM $0 / CUSTOM $15. ELITE tier: unlimited replacements, no waiting period, delivery_fee $0 for STANDARD, EXPEDITED and RUSH, all designs $0, same-day shipping if ordered before 2pm EST. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_029]

Checking account tier mapping (personal): ENTRY TIER = Light Blue Account, Light Green Account, Green Fee-Free Account; MID TIER = Blue Account, Green Account (checking); PREMIUM TIER = Evergreen Account; ELITE TIER = Bluest Account. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_005]

Standard debit card ordering procedure steps: verify identity, confirm the checking account, check eligibility, ask preferred delivery option (STANDARD, EXPEDITED, or RUSH) and explain fees, ask preferred card design (CLASSIC, PREMIUM, or CUSTOM) and explain fees, confirm the mailing address, then use order_debit_card_5739 and state expected delivery timeframe and fees. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_023]

General delivery options for debit cards: STANDARD free (7-10 business days), EXPEDITED $15 fee (3-5 business days), RUSH $35 fee (1-2 business days); fees may vary based on account tier. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_023]

Card design options: CLASSIC = standard Rho-Bank blue design (default, no fee), PREMIUM = metallic silver finish ($10 one-time fee), CUSTOM = customer-uploaded image ($25 one-time fee, subject to approval). [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_023]

Debit card ordering eligibility: verified customer, checking account (account_type 'checking') with status OPEN, open at least 3 business days, no more than 1 active debit card per checking account, minimum balance $25, customer at least 18, no pending debit card order for the same account, and a valid US domestic address (no international shipping). [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_023]

Expedited and rush delivery fees are automatically deducted from the linked checking account, and the order will fail if the account has insufficient funds for delivery or design fees. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_023]

Replacement history is checked by retrieving all cards for the account and counting cards with issue_reason 'lost', 'stolen', 'fraud' or 'damaged' issued in the last 12 months; cards with issue_reason new_account, first_card, expired, upgrade or bank_reissue do not count toward the limit. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_029]

A card reported STOLEN (decline CODE 43) requires ENHANCED verification (full name, DOB, last 4 of SSN, confirmation of 2-3 recent transactions), cannot be reactivated, and a replacement with a new number must be ordered; the agent must not immediately offer to unfreeze or reactivate it. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_037]

Replacement debit cards (issue_reason 'lost', 'stolen', or 'fraud') must be activated with activate_debit_card_8292 (not 8291/8293); after activation remind the customer to review recent transactions for unauthorized charges. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_024]

get_debit_cards_by_account_id_7823(account_id) returns card_id, status (ACTIVE, PENDING, FROZEN, CLOSED), issue_reason, date_issued, card_design (CLASSIC, PREMIUM, CUSTOM) and daily limits — used before closing and before ordering to confirm status, card_id and replacement history. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_028]

Credit card transaction disputes (including unauthorized/fraudulent charges) are filed by the agent using the file_credit_card_transaction_dispute_4829 tool; the agent must first unlock the tool with unlock_discoverable_agent_tool and then call it with call_discoverable_agent_tool passing a JSON string of all required arguments. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_014]

The card_action value 'cancel_and_reissue' is used when the card is being cancelled and a replacement issued, and applies whether the replacement was already ordered via order_replacement_credit_card_7291 or the cancellation happens as part of the dispute — i.e. it is still the correct value for cards already cancelled and replaced. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_014]

file_credit_card_transaction_dispute_4829 requires transaction_id, card_action, card_last_4_digits, full_name, user_id, phone, email, address, contacted_merchant, purchase_date, issue_noticed_date, dispute_reason, resolution_requested, optional partial_refund_amount, and eligible_for_provisional_credit. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_014]
dispute_reason 'unauthorized_fraudulent_charge' is the value for a charge that was not authorized or is fraudulent. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_014]

contacted_merchant is a required boolean on the credit card dispute tool, but merchant contact is only a substantive requirement for non-fraud disputes; for 'unauthorized_fraudulent_charge' the customer is not required to have contacted the merchant first. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_014]
eligible_for_provisional_credit must be determined by the agent using the Provisional Credit Eligibility Guidelines and passed as true or false. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_014]

Credit card provisional credit requires ALL of: account open at least 60 days; dispute reason is 'unauthorized_fraudulent_charge', 'duplicate_charge', or 'goods_services_not_received' (purchase >30 days ago); transaction amount at least $25.00 and not exceeding the card tier's maximum provisional credit limit; no more than 2 disputes filed in the past 12 months; and (for non-fraud reasons only) merchant contacted first. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_015]

Maximum credit card provisional credit by tier: Entry Tier (Bronze Rewards, EcoCard, Business Bronze, Crypto-Cash Back) $2500.00; Mid Tier (Silver Rewards, Business Silver, Green Rewards, Silver Zoom) $5000.00; Premium Tier (Gold Rewards, Business Gold) $10000.00; Elite Tier (Platinum Rewards, Business Platinum) $15000.00; Invitation Tier (Diamond Elite) $25000.00. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_015]

Credit card disputes are NOT eligible for provisional credit if the account is under 60 days old, the reason is 'incorrect_amount', 'goods_services_not_as_described', 'canceled_subscription_still_charging' or 'refund_never_processed', the amount is under $25.00 or exceeds the tier cap, or (for non-fraud disputes) the merchant was not contacted first. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_015]

Credit card dispute history (needed for the 'no more than 2 disputes in the past 12 months' test) is retrieved with get_user_dispute_history_7291(user_id), which returns dispute_id, dispute_date, status, transaction_id, transaction_date, merchant_name, amount, currency and card_last4. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_016]

Provisional credit on a credit card is a temporary credit applied usually within a few business days of the dispute being filed; it becomes permanent if the dispute is resolved in the customer's favor and is reversed (charge reappears) if not. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_022]

Credit card investigation duration is not fixed in the KB — it 'can take anywhere from a few days to several weeks depending on the complexity of the case'. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_022]

Customer-facing guidance: unauthorized/fraudulent charges are a valid dispute reason; contacting the merchant first is recommended generally, but for charges that appear fraudulent customers are told to contact Rho-Bank right away; representatives gather the information and file the dispute on the customer's behalf. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_018]

Replacement credit cards are ordered with order_replacement_credit_card_7291 (unlock then call_discoverable_agent_tool) with reason one of fraud_suspected, lost, stolen, damaged, expired, or other; ordering automatically cancels the old card. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_replacements_001]

Credit card replacement shipping fees by tier: Standard 7-10 business days free; Expedited 2-3 business days costs $15.00 for Entry tier (Bronze Rewards, EcoCard, Business Bronze), $10.00 for Mid tier, and $0.00 (complimentary) for Premium tier and above (Gold, Platinum, Diamond Elite). [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_replacements_001]

For replacement reasons fraud_suspected or stolen, the agent should strongly recommend expedited shipping and remind the customer to review recent transactions and dispute any unauthorized charges. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_replacements_001]

The lost/stolen cross-product security protocol has the agent themselves complete the debit freeze/close, check for credit cards with get_credit_card_accounts_by_user, and offer a credit card replacement — it does not require transferring to a human or fraud team. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_030]

The documented 'escalate to security team' triggers (bank-initiated fraud alert, unverifiable identity, suspected impostor, suspicious explanation) appear in the debit-card security-alert/block management procedure governing clear_debit_card_fraud_alert_4892, not in the credit card dispute procedure. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_039]

The 60-day / 2-business-day liability deadlines and the 10-business-day provisional credit requirement are Regulation E rules that apply to debit card and electronic fund transfer disputes; Regulation E explicitly does not cover credit cards, which are covered by different regulations. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_037]

The credit card dispute tool takes card_last_4_digits (not a card_id or account_id), so the last four digits of the original cancelled card are the correct identifier to pass for each disputed transaction. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_014]

A pending dispute on a credit card account is a blocking condition for other servicing actions (e.g. credit limit increase and account closure), so filing disputes has downstream effects the agent should be aware of. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_007]
